Total: 1½ hours|difficulty=3 | image = [[File:Finished sausage breakfast casserole.jpg|300px]] }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Breakfast|Breakfast cuisine]] | [[:Category:Sausage recipes|Sausage]] | [[:Category:Cheese recipes|Cheese]] | [[:Category:Meat recipes|Meats]] | [[:Category:Bread recipes|Bread]] ==Ingredients== * 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (8-[[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) shredded [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]] * 8 large [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], [[Cookbook:Beat|beaten]] * ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onions]], tops only, sliced * 24 ounces [[Cookbook:Condensed Milk|evaporated milk]] (or substitute 3 cups of milk) * ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Onion Powder|onion powder]] * 1 teaspoon dry [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]] * ½ cup [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Red Pepper|red pepper]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] hot bulk [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]], cooked, drained, and crumbled * 8 cups (8–10 slices) ½-inch cubed [[Cookbook:French Bread|French]] or [[Cookbook:Italian Bread|Italian]] [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]] (ideally a day old or a little stale) [[File:Sausage Breakfast Casserole.jpg|thumb|Sausage Breakfast Casserole, before baking, in a 13x9 casserole pan|308x308px]] ==Procedure== # Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to {{#invoke:temperature|f|350}}. # Grease a 9 x 13-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]]. # Place bread cubes in the pan evenly. # Combine eggs, garlic powder, green onion tops, evaporated milk, onion powder, and mustard. # Pour into baking dish. # Crumble sausage over the mixture evenly. # Add cheese and peppers, if desired, over the top. # If preparing ahead, cover and refrigerate. # [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] until set, about 45 minutes. # Serve warm. ==Notes, tips, and variations== * It may be better to use 10 eggs and 2.5 cups of milk, depending on the consistency you want out of the dish. * If it is not possible to buy pre-seasoned bulk pork sausage where you live, see the recipe for [[Cookbook:bulk sausage|bulk sausage]].
